description: Trust Layer Phase 3: expanded, categorized QA set. Extends eval/dataset.json's 17 questions (kept as-is, still run by eval/run_eval.py) with questions labeled by the phase spec's categories (retrieval/answer_quality/citations/trust/failure_cases). Security, temporal, and staleness cases are NOT here — they require live setup (backdating, reupload, multi-workspace) that a static QA list can't express, so they're implemented as dedicated pass/fail functions in eval/run_expanded_eval.py instead. See that file's module docstring for exactly which spec categories map to which mechanism, and eval/EXPANDED_EVAL_README.md for the honest scope disclosure (this is NOT 300 questions).
